source.notes: ISC Class XI school quarterly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Quarterly Examination - 2018-19', 'MATHEMATICS', 'Class : XI', 'Time : 3 Hours + 15 Min.', 'Full Marks : 100' and says the extra 15 minutes are for reading only; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); it is one PDF page holding two printed pages (1 and 2) side by side. Text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against page images rendered at higher scale; fractions, powers and roots were rebuilt inline (flagged, MEDIUM). Only 'Section A (80 Marks)' (Q1–Q17) is present in the file; its printed marks add up to 96 (Q1 eleven 2-mark parts, Q2–Q12 4 marks, Q13–Q17 6 marks), not 80, and no Section B/C appears although Full Marks is 100 — the file may be incomplete. Q9's OR is printed after its second item (treated as alternatives of Q9, flagged). Q12 (graphical solution of linear inequalities) has no matching chapter in the list (chapter null). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
